summary: Semantic list of sponsors with logos and optional links.
whenToUse: Giving visibility to partners and sponsors of a community or event.
whenNotToUse: To compare plans or prices, use PricingTable.

props.name: sponsors
props.description: Sponsors with a name, logo, and optional link.

keyboard.action: Reaches the links of sponsors that have an href.

accessibility: Logos are decorative when the sponsor's visible name is present.
responsive: Items are laid out in a grid that adapts to the container.
customization: Uses CSS modules and --dc-* tokens; the logo is a ReactNode slot.
commonMistakes: Provide an understandable name even when the logo is purely graphical.
limits: Logos must be provided by the consumer.
